d0_rule: TRAIN rows only; subject identity is inherited from MMWAVE_V2_D0_SUBJECT_SPLIT_V1
d1_rule: auxiliary domain is not model-supervision eligible until reference waveform and split role are bound

fields.model_supervision_eligible: radar input valid and at least one selected target semantics available
fields.reference_target_available: reference evidence exists, even when retained as transition semantics
fields.retained_for_transition_analysis: ambiguous rows are retained but not pure-class rows
fields.subject_split_allowed: frozen D0 subject role permits the row for the current scope
fields.transition_ambiguous: event boundary or reference ambiguity is explicit
